nodes.name: Execute Sub Workflow Trigger
nodes.notes: Entry point. Called by Package Router. Receives: { mission_id, package_type, mission_number, folder_path, processing_job_id, source_platform, address, city }

nodes.name: Execute V1 Color Grade
nodes.notes: Runs video_color_grade.py. Applies color grading LUTs to video files. Self-reports status via PipelineStatusReporter (step: v1_color).

nodes.name: Parse V1 Result
nodes.notes: Parses stdout JSON from video_color_grade.py. Passes through all trigger parameters.

nodes.name: Stop on V1 Failure
nodes.notes: Script already set step to failed via PipelineStatusReporter. This stops the workflow chain.

nodes.name: Execute V1.5 Metadata
nodes.notes: Runs video_metadata.py. Extracts and uploads video metadata. Self-reports status via PipelineStatusReporter (step: v1_5_metadata).

nodes.name: Parse V1.5 Result
nodes.notes: Parses stdout JSON from video_metadata.py. Passes through all trigger parameters.

nodes.name: Stop on V1.5 Failure
nodes.notes: Script already set step to failed via PipelineStatusReporter. This stops the workflow chain.

nodes.name: Execute V2 SRT
nodes.notes: Runs srt_telemetry_parser.py. Parses SRT telemetry from video files. Self-reports status via PipelineStatusReporter (step: v2_srt).

nodes.name: Parse V2 Result
nodes.notes: Parses stdout JSON from srt_telemetry_parser.py. Passes through all trigger parameters.

nodes.name: Stop on V2 Failure
nodes.notes: Script already set step to failed via PipelineStatusReporter. This stops the workflow chain.

nodes.name: Execute V3 QA
nodes.notes: Runs video_qa.py. Quality assurance checks on video files. Self-reports status via PipelineStatusReporter (step: v3_qa).

nodes.name: Parse V3 Result
nodes.notes: Parses stdout JSON from video_qa.py. Passes through all trigger parameters.

nodes.name: Stop on V3 Failure
nodes.notes: Script already set step to failed via PipelineStatusReporter. This stops the workflow chain.

nodes.name: Execute V4 Proxy Gen
nodes.notes: Runs video_proxy_gen.py. Generates proxy video files for DaVinci Resolve editing. Self-reports status via PipelineStatusReporter (step: v4_proxy).

nodes.name: Parse V4 Result
nodes.notes: Parses stdout JSON from video_proxy_gen.py. Passes through all trigger parameters.

nodes.name: Stop on V4 Failure
nodes.notes: Script already set step to failed via PipelineStatusReporter. This stops the workflow chain.

nodes.name: V5 Gate Setup
nodes.notes: Prepares context for the V5 manual gate. Sets v5_status to awaiting_manual_edit and provides resume instructions for the operator.

nodes.name: V5 Wait for DaVinci Resolve Edit
nodes.notes:
MANUAL GATE: Workflow pauses here until operator POSTs to resume webhook.

Resume URL: {N8N_BASE_URL}/webhook-waiting/{executionId}/v5-resolve-complete

Operator actions before resuming:
1. Open DaVinci Resolve with proxy files from video/proxy/
2. Complete color grading, editing, and transitions
3. Export final masters to video/master/ directory
4. POST to resume URL to trigger V6 format export and delivery packaging

nodes.name: V5 Resume Check
nodes.notes: After Wait resumes, marks v5 as resumed. V6 will error naturally if master files are missing.

nodes.name: Execute V6 Format Export
nodes.notes: Runs video_format_export.py. Exports final video formats from DaVinci Resolve masters. Self-reports status via PipelineStatusReporter (step: v6_export).

nodes.name: Parse V6 Result
nodes.notes: Parses stdout JSON from video_format_export.py. Passes through all trigger parameters.

nodes.name: Stop on V6 Failure
nodes.notes: Script already set step to failed via PipelineStatusReporter. This stops the workflow chain.

nodes.name: Execute Delivery Packaging
nodes.notes: Runs delivery_packaging.py with --video-addendum for video packages. Uses --address and --city from drone_jobs Supabase lookup. Self-reports status via PipelineStatusReporter.

nodes.name: Parse Delivery Result
nodes.notes: Final node. Parses delivery_packaging.py result. Sets overall status to complete or failed.

main.node: V5 Wait for DaVinci Resolve Edit

_meta.description: Path V sub-workflow for video pipeline processing. Runs V1 color grade, V1.5 metadata, V2 SRT telemetry, V3 QA, V4 proxy generation in sequence with exit code guards. Pauses at V5 Wait node for DaVinci Resolve manual editing. On operator webhook POST resume, runs V6 format export and delivery packaging. Each step self-reports status via PipelineStatusReporter. Called by Package Router Execute Sub Workflow node.

parameters_expected.folder_path: Full path to mission folder on disk
parameters_expected.processing_job_id: UUID of the processing_jobs row for status reporting
